Doubling makes the same part appear again with tiny differences of timing and pitch, and with the channels separated left and right, the energy of several sources added together plus the stereo width produce a fuller, wider impression.

Small venues rely on the instruments' own volume plus a small PA; large venues rely on a complete sound system and lighting. Wedding and party bands usually play arranged pop songs, while festival bands play original material.

This idea of one instrument with two jobs is the key to the line-up.

The core is the lock between drums and bass: when the kick goes down, the bass gives the root at that same point, and the two together make a low-frequency pulse; the snare answers on beats two and four, and the hi-hat keeps the subdivision alongside. Once this lock goes slack the whole band sounds as if it is not together, even if nobody played a wrong note.

The problem it has to solve: with neither the resources of an orchestra nor the part-count of a big band, make the greatest sound pressure from the smallest line-up, while letting a song be played, recorded and passed around again and again.
擴音系統（PA）與點擊軌（click track）則在錄音與現場之間扮演關鍵角色: The PA system and the click track play a key role between the studio and the stage. When recording, bands often track separately: drums first, then bass, guitar and vocals layered on, and finally the mix. This lets each instrument have its timbre and level adjusted on its own, but it also takes away the sense of time that comes from playing together. To make up for it, a click track is often used so that everyone aligns to the same beat; live, the band relies on monitors and on seeing each other. When a band plays a large venue, each instrument goes through a microphone or a DI into the mixing desk, and the desk feeds the PA; the players hear both each other's natural sound and the processed version from the monitors, in a proportion that depends on the room and on their own setup. This changes how the band balances: it used to be the instruments' own volume, and now it also leans on the engineer's faders.

The order of the sections follows common patterns, but not every song keeps the same order; each section can also vary in length, force and timbre. The chorus is usually the thickest, loudest section and the verse thinner and quieter, and this contrast is the rock band's main way of making tension. The solo section is the guitar's or the keyboard's space, of fixed length or decided on the night.
曲目上，搖滾樂團的範圍很廣：從以吉他為主的硬式搖滾，到以鍵盤與人聲為主的流行搖滾: In repertoire the rock band's range is wide: from guitar-led hard rock to keyboard-and-vocal pop rock to funk rock built on groove and riffs. What most rock songs share is the form of a song: a singer, a chorus, sections you can recognise; instrumental rock replaces the vocal structure with riffs or soundscapes. This form lets the band play the same material in different places, and lets a listener grasp the structure on the first hearing.

The two are close in numbers and overlap in instruments, but the source of time is different: in a rock band the kick drum and the electric bass lock to the same beat and make a repeating rhythmic core that the other instruments follow; in a jazz combo the double bass changes note on every beat and the drums keep a continuous swing on the ride cymbal, with the time pushed along by the chord progression. One relies on a fixed lock, the other on a bass line that changes every beat.

注意吉他什麼時候刷和弦、什麼時候彈 riff。這兩種工作會改變聲音的厚度。: Notice when the guitar strums chords and when it plays riffs. These two jobs change the thickness of the sound.
為什麼是這三件樂器加主唱？因為它們在頻譜上剛好分工：大鼓與貝斯佔低頻，小鼓與吉他: Why these three instruments plus a singer? Because they divide the frequency spectrum neatly: kick and bass take the low end, snare and guitar the middle, hi-hat and vocals the upper middle. This division lets all four roles appear at once without covering each other, and lets the PA be adjusted band by band. Where an orchestra stacks up volume with the number of players, a rock band gets it from amplification and a division of the spectrum — two different solutions to the same problem.

A big band's music is written down; a rock band's songs are carried by memory and rehearsal, with the sections fixed but the timbre and the length free to differ each time.

，是搖滾樂團最實際的分野。一種樂團把歌當成「一份要重現的編曲」：每個段落、每個: , is the most practical dividing line in a rock band. One kind of band treats the song as an arrangement to be reproduced: every section, every fill, every harmony fixed, the live show almost identical to the recording. The other treats the song as a structure that can be played again: the chords and sections fixed, but tempo, timbre, solo length and even the order of the sections free to change. The first needs rehearsal and memory, the second needs listening and rapport. Neither is above the other, but they ask different things of the player: the first asks for precision, the second for reaction.
